How it works

01 — Add account
Click + → Claude opens empty → you log in once (Email or Google). We save an isolated profile — chats never lost.
02 — Switch in 2 sec
Click Switch → Claude restarts with the other profile. No chat loss, ever.
03 — Stay organized
Each account keeps its own chats and projects. Optional: Move profiles to external disk (1 click).

How licensing works
1. Buy once — $9.99 per extra account (Stripe Checkout, one-time, no subscription).
2. You get a license key CLAUDE-SWITCHER-XXXX-XXXX by email.
3. Paste the key in the app → Settings → License → app calls POST /api/validate.
4. If valid, the app unlocks + Add Account. The key is saved locally and cached for 7 days for offline use.
